fields.v: Yes (1): every rollout is judged by hidden acceptance tests (validated against the gold patch, the base repository and requirement-breaking mutants, then refined with a blind solver) plus an independent LLM quality judge, not by the authors' judgement; test accuracy itself checked only against LLM (gpt-6-astra) labels
fields.quote: A candidate rollout is counted as pass if and only if it passes every scenario in the hidden test suite (MechanicalResolved, Section 3.4) and satisfies the engineering-quality gate (QualityResolved, Eq. 1):
fields.why: Agent outcomes are measured against hidden acceptance tests, which the protocol lists as an independent criterion, so Yes is defensible; Partly rests on the tests being LLM-generated.
fields.doubt: Os agentes são avaliados por testes de aceitação escondidos (gerados por LLM, mas validados contra o patch de referência, mutantes e um solver cego) e por um juiz LLM. Pelo §5, testes de aceitação contam como critério independente. Vê a pág. 8 e decide Q5: Sim, ou Parcial por os testes serem gerados por LLM.
